key_entities: plan-review criteria E4, T2, T3, T5b
propositions: A primary dedup guard (BindingStore.is_comment_mapped) was inert in production because the comment_ids map was never populated, remaining empty from feature launch (2026-08-15) until the fix landed (2026-08-20)
The dedup tests seed invariants at layer boundaries rather than crossing seams, so they passed even when the primary skip was disabled end-to-end during the escape window
Plan-review and code-review criteria scopes abstained on or stopped just short of detecting silently-inert fail-open guards on correctness paths
A fallback body-equality dedup absorbed enough traffic to mask the primary skip's failure as partial success rather than total failure, correlating with comment content shape
No production-layer observability existed to detect the invariant violation that comment_ids remained empty while bindings grew and outbound posts succeeded
